_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on the World of PADMAN egg in https://github.com/pelican-eggs/games-standalone (MIT).
name: World of PADMAN
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: World of PADMAN, the free comic-style arena shooter. Runs the dedicated server with the game's map rotation; more settings are in the config file in the wop folder.
startup: exec ./wopded.x86_64 +set fs_homepath . +set fs_basepath . +set fs_game {{FS_GAME}} +set dedicated {{DEDICATED_TYPE}} +set net_port {{SERVER_PORT}} +exec "{{SERVER_CONFIG}}" +sv_hostName "{{SERVER_HOSTNAME}}" +sv_maxClients {{MAX_PLAYERS}} +sv_allowDownload {{ALLOW_DOWNLOAD}} +rconPassword "{{RCON_PASSWORD}}" +vstr nextmap

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# World of PADMAN: downloads a release from GitHub (checked against
# GitHub's checksum when it has one) and keeps only what the server needs:
# the dedicated server and the game's data. Config files the game ships are
# added only when they aren't there yet, so your edits are kept.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

repo=PadWorld-Entertainment/worldofpadman
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
build=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
trap 'rm -rf "$build"' EXIT

want="${VERSION:-latest}"
if [ "$want" = latest ]; then
    tag=$(gh-release tag "$repo") || fail "GitHub can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
else
    case "$want" in v*) ;; *) want="v$want" ;; esac
    tag=$(gh-release tag "$repo" "$want" 2>/dev/null) ||
        fail "World of PADMAN has no version $want. Set Version to latest, or to a release such as $(gh-release tag "$repo" 2>/dev/null || echo v1.7.0)."
fi
assets=$(gh-release assets "$repo" "$tag") || fail "GitHub can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
asset=$(awk '{print $1}' <<<"$assets" | grep -E 'unified\.zip$' | head -n1 || true)
[ -n "$asset" ] || fail "World of PADMAN $tag has no Linux download."

if [ -f wopded.x86_64 ] && [ "$(cat .raptor-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$tag" ]; then
    echo "World of PADMAN $tag is already installed."
else
    mkdir -p "$build/x"
    echo "Downloading World of PADMAN $tag (about 1.2 GB)"
    gh-release download "$repo" "$tag" "$asset" "$build/wop.zip" || fail "The download failed. Reinstall to try again."
    unzip -q "$build/wop.zip" 'wopded.x86_64' 'wop/*' -x 'wop/*.dylib' 'wop/*.dll' -d "$build/x"
    rm -f "$build/wop.zip"
    [ -f "$build/x/wopded.x86_64" ] || fail "World of PADMAN $tag has no Linux server in its download."
    # Config files are the server's own once they're there.
    for f in "$build"/x/wop/*.cfg; do
        if [ -e "wop/$(basename "$f")" ]; then rm -f "$f"; fi
    done
    # Files the last version had and this one doesn't (its game data) are
    # removed; nothing else is.
    (cd "$build/x" && find . -type f ! -name '*.cfg' | sort) > "$build/files"
    if [ -f .raptor-files ]; then
        comm -23 <(sort .raptor-files) "$build/files" | while read -r f; do rm -f -- "$f"; done
    fi
    mkdir -p wop
    cp -a "$build/x/." .
    mv -f "$build/files" .raptor-files
    chmod +x wopded.x86_64
    echo "$tag" > .raptor-version
fi
echo "Installed World of PADMAN $tag."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The release, such as v1.7.0, or latest for the newest one. Reinstall the server after changing it.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name shown in the server list. It can have colour codes such as ^2.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: The most players on the server, bots included.

variables.name: Visibility
variables.description: 1 for a LAN server, 2 to list it on the master server.

variables.name: Allow downloads
variables.description: Let players download maps they don't have from the server.

variables.name: RCON password
variables.description: The password for remote administration. Leave it empty to turn RCON off.

variables.name: Config file
variables.description: The config file in the game folder that the server runs.

variables.name: Game folder
variables.description: The folder with the game's data, or a mod's folder.
